vagueReviewRefinement.classificationRule: Reviews with specific functional keywords (e.g., "not opening", "verifying number", "mobile data") were extracted from the vague group into Low-Information Functional Complaints with Unknown technical cause.

evidenceQualityFlags.rule: Isolated keywords without contextual narrative are treated as thematic indicators only and do not support technical root-cause hypotheses.

ratingModalFinding.evidenceQuote: forcing me to give rating after every ride, so I came here to give you 1 star. because if I don't rate, I can't use the app as there is no skip option.
ratingModalFinding.findingDescription: At least one reviewer explicitly stated that the mandatory rating flow motivated their 1-star Play Store review.
ratingModalFinding.extrapolationConstraint: This finding is recorded as an empirical instance of policy friction; it is not extrapolated into a population-level percentage or causal claim.

crossThemeFrequencyLabeling.rule: All cross-theme metrics are explicitly labeled as non-unique review occurrences to prevent double-counting of affected users.
